title: Box / View
description: gpui's div() is the box. Ely adds nothing.

title: Text
description: A string is an element. StyledText adds runs.

title: Icon
description: Bundled Lucide or an application's SVG asset, drawn as a themed mask.

title: IconSet / IconRegistry
description: IconName lists every bundled icon. Hover for its name.

title: Svg
description: gpui's svg(). Any path from the asset source, tinted.

title: Image
description: Loading pulses. Failure and emptiness show a quiet mark.

title: Canvas
description: gpui's canvas(). Paint with paths.

title: Divider / Separator
description: One hairline. Across, down, or holding a word.

title: Spacer
description: flex_1() takes the slack. No component needed.

title: Portal
description: deferred(anchored()) escapes clipping and paints on top.

title: Overlay / Backdrop
description: A scrim that fades in, blocks the page, and hears outside clicks.

title: Slot
description: Take impl IntoElement. The caller fills the hole.

title: Show / When
description: .when() and .when_some() branch inside a builder.

title: For / Each
description: .children() takes any iterator.

title: Fragment
description: Return several elements; the parent adopts them.

title: VisuallyHidden
description: Text for screen readers only.

title: FocusRing
description: Any focusable element. Press Tab to walk these.

title: FocusScope / FocusTrap
description: Tab into the box. Tab then circles inside it.

title: ClickOutside
description: on_mouse_down_out closes what the pointer left.

title: HoverArea
description: on_hover reports enter and leave. .hover() restyles.

title: Pressable
description: Knows when it is held. Hold half a second for a long press.

title: KeyboardHandler
description: on_key_down on a focused element. Click, then type.

title: Measure
description: Reports bounds when they change. This is also the ResizeObserver.

title: IntersectionObserver
description: Scroll the box. The marker reports entering and leaving.

title: Clipboard
description: write_to_clipboard and read_from_clipboard_async on App; a browser asks before it hands the clipboard over.

title: Tooltip Trigger
description: gpui's trigger with Ely's body, or Ely's own trigger for delay and tracking.

title: Heading (H1–H6)
description: Six steps, one weight. Size carries the order.

title: Title / Subtitle
description: A pair for page and panel headers.

title: Paragraph
description: Reading text at 14 with loose leading.

title: Label
description: Names a control or a value.

title: Caption
description: The quiet line beneath.

title: Overline
description: An eyebrow in small capitals.

title: Code
description: Monospace on a quiet fill.

title: Kbd
description: gpui key syntax. secondary means ⌘ on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.

title: KbdCombo
description: Sequences read left to right.

title: Blockquote
description: A rule and a softer ink.

title: Highlight / Mark
description: Every match of a query, case-insensitive.

title: Truncate / Ellipsis
description: One line, an ellipsis at the end, in the text style around it, cut by the shaped line at the width its box gets.

title: LineClamp
description: gpui's .line_clamp(n): n lines, then a hard cut.

title: MiddleEllipsis
description: Cuts the middle so both ends stay legible.

title: EllipsisTooltip
description: Hover shows the whole line, only when it was cut.

title: Link
description: Blue marks where a click goes. Underline on hover.

title: ExternalLink
description: Leaves the app. The arrow says so.

title: RelativeTime
description: Refreshes every thirty seconds while on screen.

title: DateTimeText
description: strftime patterns in the system zone.

title: NumberText
description: Grouped, fixed precision, tabular figures.

title: CurrencyText
description: ISO 4217 codes. Yen and won have no minor units.

title: PercentText
description: Signed values carry direction in word and color.

title: FileSizeText
description: Decimal units by default, binary on request.

title: DurationText
description: A clock for media, a compact span for logs.

title: PluralText
description: The noun follows the count.

title: CopyableText
description: One click copies. A check confirms, then leaves.

title: SelectableText
description: Drag to select. ⌘C copies, ⌘A takes it all.

title: Emoji
description: Shortcodes resolve to the system color font.

title: Latex / MathInline
description: A TeX subset: scripts, fractions, roots, Greek.

title: AnimatedNumber
description: Digits roll by place; or the value counts up.

title: Typewriter
description: Reveals by grapheme, so emoji and CJK stay whole.

title: GradientText
description: A tonal ramp, glyph by glyph. No neon.

title: ShimmerText
description: A slow band of light while something loads.

title: Stack / HStack / VStack
description: h_stack() and v_stack(): flex rows and columns.

title: Flex
description: gpui's .flex(), with grow and justify.

title: Grid / GridItem
description: gpui's .grid() and .col_span().

title: SimpleGrid
description: As many equal columns as fit at a minimum width.

title: Masonry
description: Each item joins the shortest column.

title: Center
description: flex, items_center, justify_center.

title: Container
description: A centered column capped by a width token.

title: AspectRatio
description: Width fills; height follows the ratio.

title: Inset / Padding
description: gpui's .p_*() on the rem scale.

title: Wrap
description: gpui's .flex_wrap() moves overflow to the next line.

title: Absolute / Positioned
description: gpui's .absolute() with edge offsets.

title: Layer / ZStack
description: The first child sets the size; the rest cover it.

title: ScrollArea
description: Overlay scrollbars appear while scrolling or hovered.

title: Scrollbar
description: Any ScrollHandle can wear one. Drag the thumb.

title: ScrollShadow
description: A soft edge wherever more content waits.

title: ScrollToTop
description: Past half a screen, a button eases back up.

title: StickyHeader
description: Each group's header pins until the next pushes it off.

title: SplitPane
description: Drag a divider. Panes nest across and down.

title: ResizeHandle
description: A hairline with a wide grab. Hover lights it.

title: Collapsible
description: Height animates to the measured content.

title: Accordion / AccordionItem
description: One open at a time. The chevron turns with it.

title: Card / CardHeader / CardBody / CardFooter
description: Flat: a hairline, no shadow.

title: Panel / PanelHeader
description: An app region: a quiet header bar and a body.

title: Section / SectionHeader
description: A page block: title, note, action.

title: Group / Fieldset
description: Related fields under one name.

title: Frame
description: A bordered region with no fill.

title: Well
description: A recessed region on the sunken tone.

title: Sidebar
description: Folds to an icon rail; the width eases.

title: Drawer
description: Rises from the bottom. Pull the handle down to dismiss.

title: Sheet
description: Slides in from an edge over a scrim.

title: Page / PageHeader / PageContent
description: Title, note and actions over the body.

title: AppShell
description: Title bar, sidebar, content, status bar.

title: MasterDetail
description: A list beside the chosen item. The divider drags.

title: Dock / DockPanel
description: Panels dock on any edge, tab together, and float.

title: DockZone / DropIndicator
description: While a tab drags, the drop zones appear and the one below lights.

title: FloatingPanel
description: Drag the title bar. It stays inside the window.

title: Pane / PaneGroup
description: Split right or down from any pane; close all but one.

title: Workspace
description: Layout to versioned JSON and back, all or nothing.

title: Viewport
description: Drag to pan. Hold ⌘ or Ctrl and scroll to zoom at the pointer.

title: TitleBar
description: Title centered, system buttons in their place, empty space drags.

title: ColumnShell / ShellColumn
description: The sidebar runs to the window's top; each column brings a header that drags.

title: WindowControls / TrafficLights
description: Three manners. Hover the lights for their glyphs.

title: WindowDragRegion
description: Windows hit-tests it natively, Linux moves by hand, double-click zooms.

title: WindowResizeBorder
description: A margin to resize from, a hairline, a shadow, for client-drawn windows.

title: NativeMenu / MenuBar / JumpList
description: One menu model: the system bar, the Dock, and later the window.

title: Toolbar / ToolbarGroup / ToolbarSeparator
description: Tools in groups, hairlines between, one action apart.

title: StatusBar / StatusBarItem
description: Small type at the foot. Items that act show it on hover.

title: ActivityBar / NavigationRail
description: An icon rail. The mark grows in beside the chosen view.

title: TabBar
description: Window tabs. New ones rise in; drag one onto another to reorder.

title: SplashScreen
description: Mark and name rise in; the bar reports progress or sweeps.

title: AboutDialog
description: Name, version to copy, links, fine print.

title: TrayIcon / TrayMenu
description: An SF Symbol in the menu bar with a menu. macOS only.

title: DockBadge
description: A count on the app's Dock icon. macOS only.

title: SystemNotification
description: Notices from the system's own center.

title: MultiWindow Manager
description: Each new window cascades from the last; the manager knows them by name.

title: WindowSwitcher
description: Managed windows over a scrim. Arrows or Tab move, Enter goes.

title: QuickLauncher
description: A search palette in a window above all others.

title: MiniWindow / CompactMode / PictureInPicture
description: Small windows above the rest. Hover for the bar; expand returns to the app.

title: UpdateBanner
description: Offer, download, restart. One slim bar, three states.

title: UpdateDialog
description: What changed, then one clear action.

title: CrashReporter
description: Plain words first. The report waits behind a disclosure.

title: OfflineIndicator
description: Quiet while it matters, gone soon after the network returns.

title: ZoomControl
description: Scales the whole window through its rem size. Click the number to reset.

title: Button
description: Primary is ink. Color is saved for meaning.

title: Sizes
description: Heights follow density. Tab moves the focus ring.

title: With icons
description: Leading icon for verbs. Trailing for menus.

title: Icon button
description: Square. Ghost by default.

title: ShortcutHint
description: The keystroke rides along, quiet, in the platform's spelling.

title: ButtonGroup
description: Buttons joined edge to edge.

title: SplitButton / DropdownButton / MenuButton / LoadingButton
description: Built from parts in later chapters.

title: ToggleButton
description: Stays pressed until pressed again.

title: ToggleGroup
description: Several at once for marks; one at a time for alignment.

title: SegmentedControl
description: One of a few. The thumb springs to the choice.

title: FloatingActionButton
description: Round and raised for the screen's one main action. It rises in.

title: ConfirmButton / HoldToConfirm
description: Hold until the fill completes, or click twice within three seconds.

title: CopyButton / ShareButton / CloseButton / BackButton / MoreButton
description: Small, familiar verbs. Each names itself on hover.

title: ActionBar
description: Docked along a panel's foot, or floating as a pill.

title: BulkActionBar
description: Rises once rows are selected. The count rolls as it changes.

title: ActionSheet
description: A few choices from the bottom, and a separate way out.

title: QuickActions
description: Common moves with their keys. Arrows choose, Enter runs.

title: Input / TextField / ClearableInput
description: One line. Undo, word jumps, IME and the clipboard come built in.

title: TextArea / AutoResizeInput
description: Several lines. It grows to its content, then scrolls.

title: PasswordInput
description: Bullets by default; the eye shows the text. Masked text never reaches the clipboard.

title: SearchInput
description: A magnifier, a clear button, and recent searches while it is empty.

title: NumberInput
description: Arrow keys or the stepper move it; drag the grip sideways to scrub.

title: ScrubInput
description: Drag the label sideways, as in a design tool. The field still types.

title: CurrencyInput / PercentInput / UnitInput
description: The same number field with a symbol, a percent, or a unit you click through.

title: EmailInput / UrlInput
description: Checked once you leave the field; a quiet note says what fits.

title: PhoneInput / MaskedInput
description: Typing fits the pattern; literals appear on their own.

title: PinInput / OTPInput
description: Six boxes, one field underneath: type, paste, or backspace through them.

title: InlineEdit / EditableText
description: Click the text to edit. Enter or leaving keeps it; Escape puts it back.

title: InputGroup / InputAddon
description: Addons join the field's frame: a scheme before, a unit or a control after.

title: MentionInput / HashtagInput
description: @ and # open suggestions at the caret. Arrows choose, Enter picks.

title: TagInput / TokenInput
description: Enter or a comma adds a chip; Backspace on an empty field drops the last.

title: KeyValueInput / ListInput
description: Rows you add and remove. Each row reports as you type.

title: PathInput
description: Type a path, or Browse with the system's dialog.

title: RegexInput
description: Colored by part as you type; a broken pattern says why.

title: ExpressionInput
description: A formula, colored and evaluated as you type.

title: HotkeyInput / ShortcutRecorder
description: Focus it and press a shortcut; it keeps that one and lets go.

title: Checkbox / CheckboxGroup
description: On, off, or mixed when a parent's children disagree. The check pops in.

title: Radio / RadioGroup
description: One Tab stop per group; the arrow keys move the choice.

title: CheckboxCard / RadioCard
description: Larger targets that explain a choice. The chosen border turns to ink.

title: Switch / Toggle
description: Takes effect at once. The thumb slides with a little overshoot.

title: Select / NativeSelect
description: A button that opens its list. Arrows move, Enter picks, Escape closes.

title: ListBox
description: A list chosen from in place. Focus it and use the arrows, Space or Enter.

title: Combobox / Autocomplete
description: Type to filter. A combobox keeps a listed value; an autocomplete keeps any text.

title: MultiSelect
description: Several values as chips. The list stays open while you pick; Backspace drops the last.

title: CascadeSelect / Cascader
description: Each column opens the next. Right and Left walk the levels; a leaf picks the path.

title: TransferList
description: Mark rows on one side, then move them across.

title: ChoiceChips / FilterChips
description: Pills for a few options. Filter chips toggle and show a check.

title: Rating
description: Hover previews, a click sets it, and clicking the same star clears it.

title: Slider / RangeSlider / VerticalSlider
description: Drag a thumb, click the track, or use the arrows; Page keys jump ten steps.

title: Knob / Dial / Stepper
description: Drag a knob up or down, or use the arrows. The stepper counts without typing.

title: Calendar
description: Arrows move a cursor, Page keys turn the month, Enter picks. Today wears a ring.

title: DatePicker / DateRangePicker / DateTimePicker / TimePicker
description: Fields that open a calendar or time columns. Two clicks set a span.

title: MonthPicker / YearPicker / QuarterPicker / WeekPicker
description: Pages of periods; arrows move, Page keys turn the page. Weeks follow ISO 8601.

title: RelativeDatePicker / TimezoneSelect / DurationPicker
description: Spans named from today, every zone the system knows, and hours and minutes.

title: CronEditor
description: Five fields, read back in words with the next runs. Presets fill it in.

title: ColorPicker
description: Saturation and value on the plane, hue and alpha on the rails. Type it as hex, RGB or HSV; drag a letter to scrub.

title: ColorSwatch / ColorPalette / EyeDropper
description: Named patches; see-through colors sit on a checkerboard. The dropper reads the screen.

title: GradientEditor
description: Click the bar to add a stop, drag stops to move them, Delete removes the chosen one.

title: FileInput / DropZone
description: Click a field or Browse for the system's dialog, or drop files from Finder. A folder, or two files on a one-file target, turns it red.

title: SignaturePad
description: Sign with the pointer. A stroke lands when the pen lifts; Clear starts over.

title: CodeInput / JsonInput
description: One line of code, colored the way most languages read. JSON is checked as you type.

title: FontPicker
description: Every family the system knows, and a line set in the chosen one.

title: IconPicker / EmojiPicker
description: Type to narrow. Down moves into the grid, arrows walk it, Enter picks.

title: LanguageSelect / CountrySelect / CurrencySelect
description: Languages under their own names, countries with flags, currencies by ISO 4217. Type a name or a code.

title: Form / FormSection / FormField / FieldArray / DirtyIndicator
description: Sections with room between them. Errors take the description's place; Cmd-Enter saves from any field.

title: InlineForm
description: Fields and actions in one row, their bottoms aligned.

title: Tabs
description: A line slides to the chosen tab. Arrows move it; disabled tabs are skipped.

title: EditorTabs / TabOverflowMenu
description: Close, pin, drag to reorder. A dot marks unsaved work until you hover; italics mark a preview. The chevron lists every tab.

title: Breadcrumb
description: Each level is a place. A level with siblings opens them, the way an editor's path bar does.

title: Pagination
description: The first, the last, and the pages around this one. A gap stands for two or more pages. Type a page to go there.

title: Steps / Wizard
description: Finished steps carry a check and take you back. The line into the current step fills as you advance.

title: Sidebar Navigation / NavItem / NavGroup
description: Places in a side column. Groups fold; folded to a rail, items keep their icons and name themselves on hover.

title: NavigationMenu
description: A click opens an entry's panel; while one is open, hovering another switches. Arrows walk it, Escape closes.

title: BackForwardNavigation / History
description: Back and forward step one place; the clock lists every place, newest first.

title: Anchor / TableOfContents
description: Anchors mark where sections start. The table marks the one in view and brings any to the top.

title: JumpTo / GoToLine
description: Line, or line and column. The note says where you will land, or why you cannot.

title: CommandPalette
description: Every command in one place. Recent ones lead; typing ranks fuzzy matches and marks the letters that matched.

title: QuickOpen
description: Files by path. The name leads and its folder follows; recent files show before you type.

title: QuickSwitcher
description: Documents, sessions and projects, most recent first. It opens on the one before, so Enter goes back.

title: SearchPalette / SpotlightSearch / QuickLauncher
description: One field searches everywhere and marks each match. As a launcher it opens alone, above every window, and closes when you look away.

title: Menu / MenuItem / MenuGroup / MenuSeparator / SubMenu / MenuItemShortcut / MenuItemIcon
description: Rows with an icon and a key hint, split by rules and titled groups. The hint only shows a chord; the app binds it. A row with an arrow opens the next menu beside it; Right and Left walk in and out.

title: CheckboxMenuItem / RadioMenuItem
description: A check flips on its own; a radio is one of its group. The owner holds both and redraws the menu.

title: DropdownMenu / SplitButton / OverflowMenu
description: A button that opens a menu; a main action with related ones under its arrow; and More, for what did not fit.

title: ContextMenu
description: A right click opens the menu where it lands; it stays inside the window.

title: MenuBar Menu
description: The app's own menus, the ones cx.set_menus gave the system, drawn in the window. Picking a row dispatches its action.

title: MegaMenu
description: A menu of links wide enough for a line of detail each.

title: SearchableMenu
description: A filter field heads the menu. Typing narrows the rows, best first, and marks the letters that matched.

title: PieMenu / RadialMenu
description: A right click opens a ring at the pointer. The pointer's direction marks a slice and a click runs it; arrows turn the ring, the hub cancels.

title: Popover / DropdownPanel / InlinePopup
description: A panel of any content under its button. A press outside or Escape closes it, and Tab stays inside. The Link variant sets the trigger inline.

title: HoverCard
description: Rest the pointer on a name and a card opens. It stays while the pointer is on either, and never takes focus.

title: Dialog / Modal / AlertDialog / ConfirmDialog / PromptDialog / FullscreenDialog
description: A card over a scrim; Tab stays inside and focus returns on close. An alert holds until acknowledged, a confirm asks first, a prompt checks its one line, and a fullscreen dialog fills the window.

title: Lightbox
description: A picture over a dark layer, one at a time. Arrows step, Escape or a press on the dark closes it, and each picture fades in.

title: Spotlight / Coachmark / Tour
description: The window dims around one control and a card explains it. A tour walks the stops; the lit box glides from one to the next.

title: FloatingToolbar
description: Tools float over a selection while the field has focus, and leave focus where it is.

title: Callout / Peek
description: A panel opens in the flow under its line, the way an editor peeks at a definition, and pushes what follows down.

title: Tooltip / Sheet / Drawer / DropdownPanel / InlinePopup / ToastViewport
description: They live with the pieces they are made of.

title: Toast / Snackbar / UndoToast
description: Short messages stack in the corner, the newest nearest it. Each rises in as its room opens and folds away under the rest. The pointer on the stack holds their time.

title: Notification / NotificationCenter
description: Messages under day headings. Unread ones carry a dot; Mark all read and Clear show only while they have work.

title: Alert
description: A message in the flow of the page, tinted by how much it matters.

title: Banner
description: A strip across the top of a window. Closing it folds it away.

title: Callout / Admonition
description: A note set apart in reading: note, tip, warning and danger.

title: InlineMessage / StatusMessage
description: One line beside what it is about. A status line rises in each time it changes.

title: EmptyState
description: What a view shows with nothing in it: no data yet, no results, or a first start.

title: ErrorView / NotFound / NoPermission / Maintenance / Offline
description: A view that could not show what was asked says what happened and offers a way on.

title: ErrorBoundary
description: Shows its content, or the error it holds, logged once. It renders a Result; it never catches a panic.

title: Result
description: Where a task ended. The ring and its mark draw themselves once.

title: ConfirmationCard
description: Asks in place before an action runs, with what it will do.

title: SavingIndicator / SyncStatus / ConnectionStatus
description: Quiet lines for work in the background. Each rises in when its state changes; sync arrows turn while they work.

title: Countdown / Timer
description: Time left and time spent. Digits roll as they change.

title: Spinner / DotsLoader / BarsLoader / PulseLoader / RingLoader / OrbitLoader / WaveLoader / InlineLoader
description: Six small motions for waiting, one component. Under reduced motion each rests on one frame.

title: Skeleton / SkeletonText / SkeletonAvatar / SkeletonCard / SkeletonTable
description: Placeholders in the shape of what is coming. They breathe together, slowly.

title: Shimmer
description: A soft band of light sweeps what is loading. Load swaps in the content.

title: LoadingButton
description: A button spins in place at the same width and ignores presses until the work is done.

title: LoadMore
description: A list that loads in pages ends in one button. It spins while the next page comes, and counts what shows.

title: ProgressBar / ProgressCircle / ProgressRing
description: A track that fills and glides to each new value; a sweep when none is known; a buffer ahead; steps as segments; the same in a ring.

title: LoadingOverlay
description: A veil and a spinner over what is reloading. Presses stop at the veil; it fades in and out.

title: LazyLoad
description: Rows build only once they scroll into view; a skeleton holds each place until then. Scroll the list.

title: Suspense / AsyncView
description: A spinner while a value loads off the main thread, then the value as it fades in, or the error with Try again.

title: RefreshIndicator / TypingIndicator
description: An arrow that turns with a pull, a spinner while it works, a check when done. Someone typing, as three dots in a bubble.

title: UploadList
description: Files on their way up: the percent and a bar that glides while they go, then their size and a check, or why they failed and a way to retry.

title: Transition
description: Content that fades, rises or slides in, and leaves the way it came.

title: Stagger
description: Children arrive one after another, a few frames apart.

title: AnimatePresence
description: Rows fold open as they arrive and fold away as they go; the rest glide to close the gap.

title: Flip
description: When the order changes, each row glides from where it was to where it goes.

title: Reorder
description: Drag a row: it follows the pointer and the others glide aside to make room.

title: Marquee
description: A line that runs past at an even pace, with no seam where it loops.

title: Ripple / Confetti
description: A circle of light spreads from each press, cut to the card's corners. A burst of paper for a real win, in the chart's quiet colors.

title: Glow / Pulse
description: A soft light that breathes around a card; rings that call out a live dot.

title: Blink / Flash / Shake
description: A caret's rhythm; a tint that fades when a value moves; a side-to-side no for a wrong entry.

title: ParticleBackground / AnimatedGradient / Lottie Player
description: Faint motes that drift behind a panel; a tone that drifts, slowly, a breath toward the accent.

title: Badge / CountBadge / DotBadge
description: Small labels tinted by what they mean, counts whose digits roll, and a dot for something new.

title: Tag / Chip
description: Short labels for a kind, a topic or a filter; an x takes one away.

title: Avatar / AvatarUpload
description: A picture, or initials on a tone the name keeps, or an icon. Presence sits on the corner. Hover the last one, then press it to choose a picture, or drop one on it.

title: AvatarGroup / UserChip
description: People side by side, each tucked under the next, with a count of the rest; someone named inline.

title: Statistic / KPI Card / Metric / TrendIndicator
description: Figures that matter, rolling to each new value, with how they moved. For latency, down is the good way.

title: DescriptionList / KeyValueList / InfoRow
description: Labels and their values: in a quiet column beside them, or stacked where room is narrow.

title: PropertyGrid
description: An inspector: groups fold, each row a name and its editor. The owner keeps the values; the frame on the right follows them.

title: Timeline / TimelineItem
description: Events down a rail, marked by an icon in a tinted ring or by a dot, with detail below.

title: ActivityFeed
description: Who did what, and when, newest first. A new entry folds in at the top; the times stay fresh.

title: Changelog
description: Releases, newest first, each change under its kind.

title: Carousel
description: Slides one at a time, gliding between them; past the last comes the first. Arrows show on hover, the dots stretch toward where it goes, and Left and Right step it. With autoplay it turns on its own and holds while pointed at.

title: Gallery
description: Pictures in square tiles. Press one, or Enter on a focused tile, to open the lightbox there.

title: BeforeAfter
description: One picture twice: flat as it came, and graded. Drag the divider, press anywhere on the picture, or use Left and Right.

title: Watermark
description: Faint text over a page, for drafts and shared screens. The rows run level, and presses reach the page below.

title: QRCode / Barcode
description: Codes for cameras and scanners: dark on a light tile in both themes, so they read anywhere. Code 128 takes printable ASCII; EAN-13 adds its own check digit.

title: Meter / Gauge / UsageBar
description: How full things are. A meter turns amber past 80% and red past 95%; a gauge rolls its number and sweeps its arc; a usage bar splits one whole into parts.

title: Stars / Rating display
description: A score in stars, read only. Parts of a star fill too; to set a score, use Rating in Forms.

title: Comparison
description: Options side by side, a row per feature. One column can stand out.

title: List / ListItem
description: Rows with something to lead with, a title and a quieter line, and something at the end. Rows that can be pressed light on hover.

title: SelectableList
description: A press picks one; Cmd-press adds or drops one, Shift-press takes a range. With focus, Up and Down move, Shift extends, Space toggles and Cmd-A takes all.

title: SortableList / ReorderableList
description: Drag a row to its new place, or focus the list and press Alt with Up or Down. The others glide aside.

title: SwipeableListItem
description: Swipe a row left with two fingers to show what can be done to it; it snaps open or shut as the fingers lift.

title: VirtualList
description: Ten thousand rows, each as tall as it needs; only those near the view are built.

title: InfiniteList
description: Scroll to the end and the next page comes, a spinner holding its place while it loads. After five pages, the list ends quietly.

title: GroupedList / SectionList
description: Rows under their letter; each letter pins to the top while its group scrolls past.

title: Tree / TreeView / VirtualTree
description: Folders open and close; Right, Left, Up and Down walk them, F2 renames, and a drag lands before, after or into a folder. Shift and Cmd widen the pick. Assets loads its children the first time it opens. Rows draw only in view, so large trees stay quick.

title: CheckboxTree
description: A box on every row. A branch's box checks all it holds, and shows a dash when only some are.

title: TreeSelect
description: A select whose choices are a tree, each indented under its parent.

title: Outline / NestedList
description: A document's headings, each level stepping in. The marker glides to the section you pick.

title: FileTree
description: A project's files: folders first, an icon for each kind, git status by letter and tint, and a dot on folders with changes. Type to filter; matches keep their folders, which open.

title: DirectoryListing
description: A folder's contents in columns. A header sorts by its column and a second press reverses it; folders stay first. Open a folder with a double press or Enter; the path above climbs back.

title: Table
description: A header and rows, hairlines between. Nothing more.

title: DataTable / TableToolbar / FilterBuilder / SortBuilder / ColumnVisibility / CellRenderer / RowSelection / TableDensity / AggregationFooter / ConditionalFormatting
description: Press a header to sort, Shift to add it to the sort. The toolbar searches, opens the filter and sort builders, hides columns, sets the density and copies the rows as CSV. Boxes select; Shift takes a range. Growth is tinted by where it sits; the footer sums and averages what the filters keep.

title: ColumnPinning / ColumnResizer / ColumnReorder
description: Team stays put while the months scroll sideways. Drag a header's right edge to resize it; drag a header onto another to move it there.

title: RowExpansion / InlineRowEdit
description: The chevron opens a row's detail beneath it. Double press a task's name to edit it; Enter keeps the change, Escape drops it.

title: RowGrouping
description: Orders gathered by region, each group with its count; a press on a group folds it.

title: DataGrid
description: Cells to edit like a spreadsheet's. Arrows walk, Shift stretches a range, typing or a double press edits, Delete clears, and Cmd-C and Cmd-V copy and paste.

title: Spreadsheet
description: Lettered columns and numbered rows. Formulas such as =SUM(B3:B7) recalculate as cells change; the title spans six merged cells; the first two rows and the first column stay put. Drag the dot at the range's corner to fill a series or carry a formula on.

title: TreeTable
description: Rows that open and close under columns; the first column steps in by depth.

title: PivotTable
description: Sales cross-tabbed: regions down the side, quarters across, summed where they meet, with totals.

title: VirtualTable
description: A hundred thousand rows; only the ones in view are drawn, so it scrolls as lightly as ten.

title: HeatmapTable
description: Visits by weekday and hour; each cell is shaded by where it sits between the quietest and the busiest.

title: LineChart / ChartAxis / ChartGrid / ChartLegend / ChartTooltip / ChartCrosshair / ChartAnnotation / ChartZoom / ChartExport
description: Hover for a crosshair and each series' value. Press a name in the legend to hide it. Drag across the chart to zoom into a span; a double press shows the whole year. The target and the launch are annotations. Copy the chart as SVG or its data as CSV.

title: AreaChart / StackedArea / BarChart
description: Areas stack each platform on the ones before it. Bars stand grouped, stacked, or run sideways.

title: PieChart / DonutChart
description: Parts of a whole, clockwise from twelve. Hover a slice: it lifts and reads its share; the donut reads it in the middle.

title: ScatterChart / BubbleChart
description: Points placed by two values; sizes turn them into bubbles whose areas compare.

title: RadarChart
description: Two products on six measures. Hover a spoke to read both; press a name to hide it.

title: HeatmapChart / CalendarHeatmap
description: Load by weekday and hour, and a year of commits a day, Monday first. Hover a cell to read it.

title: Treemap / Sunburst
description: A year's spend as tiles whose areas compare, and a company as rings: teams inside groups inside the whole. Hover to read a part.

title: SankeyChart / FunnelChart
description: A month's money from where it came to where it went, and how many of a month's visitors reached each step. Hover a node, a ribbon or a stage.

title: WaterfallChart
description: How a year's revenue became its profit: each step floats from where the last left off, and the totals stand on zero.

title: Histogram / BoxPlot / ViolinPlot
description: Response times by count in equal bins, and by region as boxes and as violins that widen where values gather.

title: GanttChart
description: A launch plan: each bar filled as far as it is done, arrows from the work it waits for, and a line at today. Hover a row.

title: NetworkGraph / ForceGraph / ChordDiagram / ParallelCoordinates
description: People and who they work with, settling as forces pull and push: drag a node, hover one to light its ties. Trade between regions around a circle, and cars on five measures at once.

title: Bullet Chart / ProgressChart
description: A quarter's measures against their targets over bands from poor to good, and a day's goals as rings that fill toward them.

title: RealtimeChart
description: A new reading every second; the line slides left as each arrives.

title: CandlestickChart / OHLCChart / HeikinAshiChart / LineQuoteChart / VolumeChart / ChartTypeSwitcher / TimeRangeSelector / IntervalSelector
description: Prices as candles, bars, smoothed candles, a line or an area, with volume along the bottom and averages over the top. Drag or scroll sideways to move through time, hold Cmd and scroll to zoom, double-press to return to the newest.

title: IndicatorOverlay / IndicatorPane / IndicatorSelector / CompareSymbol / PriceAlertLine
description: Bollinger bands over the prices, MACD and RSI in panes below, and a second symbol drawn from the same start so their moves compare. Choose indicators from the menu.

title: DrawingTools / DrawingToolbar
description: Pick a tool and drag over the prices: a trend line, a level, a box, or retracement levels between a swing's two ends. The pointer moves through time again.

title: DepthChart
description: Every bid and ask as a running total out from the spread. Hover to read the total to any price.

title: MarketProfile / VolumeProfile
description: How much traded at each price in view, as bars from the right edge; the busiest price is the darkest.

title: RenkoChart / PointAndFigure
description: Time drops out: a brick for each whole move of two dollars, and columns of Xs and Os that turn after three boxes the other way.

title: MultiChartLayout / ChartSync
description: Four symbols moving together: pan, zoom or point at one and the others follow. Switch between one chart, two across, two down or four.

title: Ticker / TickerTape / QuoteCard / PriceText / PriceChangeBadge
description: Quotes running past in a band, and symbols at a glance: the price flashes green or red as it moves, and the badge reads the move since the last close.

title: OrderBook / SpreadIndicator / BidAskBar / Level2 Quotes
description: Orders waiting on each side, best in the middle, each level shaded by its running total; the spread and the balance between sides; and each venue's quotes side by side.

title: TimeAndSales / TradeTape / MarketDepthLadder / DOM
description: Trades as they print, newest on top and large prints bold; and the book as a ladder around the last price. Press a size to trade at its price.

title: OrderEntry / TradePanel / QuickTradeButtons / OrderConfirmDialog
description: An order filled in field by field, with what it comes to; its button asks before the order goes. Quick buttons trade at the bid or the ask in one press.

title: PositionTable / OrderTable / TradeHistoryTable / PnLDisplay
description: What is held and what it has made, orders still waiting with how much has filled, and each fill with its fee. Results read green for a gain and red for a loss.

title: LeverageSlider / MarginIndicator / RiskMeter
description: Leverage marked at the common steps; the margin it takes against the account, and the risk it carries. Each turns amber, then red, as it climbs. Drag the slider.

title: OptionChain / GreeksTable / PayoffDiagram
description: Calls to the left and puts to the right of each strike, the side in the money shaded and a line at the price; a position's greeks; and what a call spread pays at expiry. Hover the diagram to read any price.

title: Watchlist / SymbolBadge / SymbolSearch
description: Symbols to follow, each with its day as a line, its price and its move; a symbol as a tile of its letters; and a search by letters or name.

title: MarketHeatmap / SectorTreemap
description: Each symbol a tile sized by its market value and tinted by its move: deeper green as it rises, deeper red as it falls. Hover a tile to read it.

title: Screener / FilterPanel
description: Securities narrowed by rules: build the rules above, and the table keeps only what passes them.

title: MarketOverview / IndexCard / MarketStatus / TradingSessionClock
description: A market at a glance: its session, its indexes as cards, and the day's movers. Below, each market's hours across one day in UTC, those open now lit.

title: EconomicCalendar / EarningsCalendar / NewsFeed
description: The day's releases with how much each moves markets and its figure beside the forecast; reports due by date; and stories newest first, each dot leaning green or red. Press a story to open it.

title: PortfolioSummary / AssetAllocationChart / PerformanceChart / SentimentGauge
description: What the portfolio is worth and how it moved, split across holdings; the same split as a donut; its growth against the market with each fall from a high below; and the market's mood on a dial.

title: DividendTable / FinancialStatementTable
description: Dividends by date with their yield, and a statement by quarter whose lines open into their parts.

title: CurrencyConverter / CryptoWalletCard / TransactionList / Candle Countdown
description: An amount in another currency, at an illustrative rate; a wallet with its balance and an address to scan; transfers in and out with whether each settled; and the time left in the current candle.

title: CodeEditor / EditorGutter / LineNumbers / FoldingControl / Minimap / Ruler / IndentGuide / BracketMatcher / RainbowBrackets / MultiCursor / SelectionHighlight / StickyScroll / Breadcrumb / InlayHints / CodeLens / InlineDecoration
description: Rust, colored as it reads. The gutter holds breakpoints, problems, numbers, folds and git marks, and the blocks around the top line stay pinned as it scrolls. Cmd-D selects the next match, Cmd-Alt-Down adds a cursor, Alt-click adds one anywhere, Cmd-/ comments, Tab indents.

title: WhitespaceRenderer / CursorRenderer
description: Dots for spaces, and the cursor as a line, a block or an underline; it blinks, and holds still under reduced motion. Numbers count from the top or from the cursor.

title: InlineDiff / GhostText / InlineChat / ReadOnlyBanner / VimModeIndicator
description: A changed line under the one it replaced; a suggestion in grey that Tab takes; a prompt between lines; a banner over code that cannot change here; and the mode of a modal editor.

title: CompletionMenu / SignatureHelp / HoverInfo
description: Completions as you type, the typed letters marked and the chosen one's documentation beside; the call's signature with the parameter at the cursor; and what a hover over a symbol reads.

title: CodeActionMenu / RenameInput / PeekView / ReferencesPanel / SymbolOutline / GoToSymbol / CallHierarchy / TypeHierarchy
description: Fixes and refactors behind a lightbulb; renaming in place; where a symbol is used; a file's symbols as a tree that follows the cursor, or as a palette to jump by name; and who calls a function.

title: FindWidget / ReplaceWidget
description: Find over code by case, whole word or pattern; the current match glows among the rest, and the arrows step between them. The replace row swaps one or every match.

title: SearchPanel / SearchResultItem / SearchFilters
description: Matches across files, each file folding away, each line trimmed near its match; globs choose which files count.

title: ProblemsPanel / DiagnosticsList / OutputPanel
description: Every problem by file, worst first, with toggles by severity; and a tool's log by channel, levels tinted, following the newest line.

title: DebugConsole / ExtensionsPanel / PluginList
description: An expression prompt beside a paused program; and extensions with their reach, rating, and the one action each needs next.

title: SettingsEditor / KeybindingsEditor
description: Settings as controls by section, each change marked with a way back, or as the JSON a settings file holds; and every command's keys, clashes marked. Double-press a command to record new keys.

title: WelcomePage / RecentProjects / ProjectSwitcher / ThemePreview / TaskRunner / RunConfiguration
description: Where an editor starts: ways in, recent projects and a switcher; each theme painted in its own colors; and tasks with how their last run went, one open to its configuration.

title: CursorPosition / LanguageMode / Encoding / LineEnding / IndentSettings / BranchIndicator / LspStatus / NotificationBell
description: The quiet row under the code. Each item says one thing and opens the one control that changes it: press the language, the line ending or the indent to switch them, the server to step through its states, the bell to read.

title: Terminal / TerminalTabs / TerminalSplit / TerminalToolbar / ShellSelector / TerminalSearch / TerminalLink
description: A real shell on a pseudo-terminal, drawn cell by cell in the theme's sixteen colors. Tabs hold shells and output; split for another shell beside it. Find lights every match through the scrollback. Cmd-press a link or a path:line.

title: CommandBlock / CommandHistory
description: Each command a block: where it ran, how it ended and how long it took, its output folding away; copy it or run it again. Past commands open as a palette, found by any of their letters.

title: AnsiText
description: Text colored by the escape codes in it, as a terminal prints it: the sixteen theme colors, bold, dim, italic, underline, inverse, the 256-color cube and true color. Other codes drop away.

title: LogViewer
description: A log from a chosen level up, filtered as you type, following new lines until a scroll up lets go. Long logs draw only the lines in view.

title: ProcessList
description: Running processes, busiest first: found by a query, sorted by any column, and the selected ones ended.

title: DiffViewer / InlineDiff
description: One file's changes, unified or side by side: each change in its context with old and new numbers, the words that changed washed, the stretches between folded until pressed. InlineDiff inside an editor is CodeEditor::set_diff.

title: ThreeWayMerge / ConflictResolver
description: Ours, the base and theirs side by side: clean changes merge themselves, each conflict waits for a side, and the result shows what is still open. In a file with markers, each conflict offers the current change, the incoming one, or both.

title: ChangesList / CommitInput
description: The work tree's changes, the staged apart, each with its status and size; hover a file to open, discard, stage or unstage it. The subject counts toward fifty; Cmd-Enter commits.

title: CommitGraph / CommitList / CommitItem
description: Commits newest first beside the lanes they take: a branch forks off, merges join, each lane in its own color; refs sit on their commits.

title: BranchSelector / BranchList / TagList / StashList
description: Branches as a palette, local and remote apart, a new name offering a new branch; the lists show how far each branch is from its upstream, tags with their messages, and stashes to apply, pop or drop.

title: BlameView / GitBlameAnnotation / FileHistory / DiffStat / GitStatusBadge
description: Who last changed each run of lines, the bar fading with age, the current line annotated; a file's commits on a line through them with what each changed; sizes as counts and five dots; statuses as letters.

title: PullRequestCard / ReviewComment
description: A pull request at a glance: state, branches, checks, reviewers, comments and size. A review thread on a line: each comment, a reply, and resolve.

title: DebugToolbar
description: The floating row that drives a session: continue or pause, the three steps while paused, restart and stop. Each tooltip names the usual key; the app binds it.

title: BreakpointList / BreakpointGutter / CallStack / ThreadList
description: Every breakpoint with its condition and hits; the stack where the program waits, library frames folded until pressed; and the threads, one picked. The gutter's breakpoints are the editor's (CodeEditor).

title: VariablesPanel / WatchPanel / ConsoleREPL
description: Variables by scope as a tree, colored by kind, with the value that changed at the last step washed; expressions watched at every step, errors in red. The REPL beside a paused program is the editor's DebugConsole.

title: MemoryViewer / HexViewer / Disassembly
description: Memory as a hex dump, sixteen bytes a row in fours beside the same bytes as text; the byte under the pointer lights on both sides and the picked one reads below as numbers. Machine code with its source lines, registers and numbers colored, the current instruction marked; press the gutter to set a breakpoint.

title: PerformanceProfiler / Flamegraph / TimelineProfiler
description: Where the time went: each function as wide as its samples with its callees under it; press a frame to zoom in and a caller to zoom back out. Work over time on tracks; the wheel zooms around the pointer and a sideways wheel pans.

title: NetworkInspector
description: Requests in the order they started, with status, kind, size and time, and a waterfall of when each ran; a filter keeps matching addresses. Press one to read its headers and body.

title: RichTextEditor / FixedFormatToolbar / FloatingFormatToolbar / LinkEditor / MentionMenu / EmojiAutocomplete / WordCount / ReadingTime
description: Markdown that reads as it is written: styles show as they are typed and their marks recede. The toolbar above and the one over a selection apply formats; ⌘K edits the link at the caret. @ suggests people, a colon and two letters suggest emoji. The foot counts words, characters and minutes.

title: MarkdownEditor
description: One document three ways: visual, where it reads as it will and a pressed block opens as its source; source, styled as typed; and split, the source beside what it makes.

title: BlockEditor / BlockHandle / SlashMenu / PlaceholderText
description: Blocks like a notebook's. Hover one for its handle: drag it to move the block, press it to turn, copy or delete it. / on an empty line lists every kind, and an empty line says so. Undo covers text and blocks alike.

title: Block types / TableEditor / ImageEditorBlock / MathEditor / DiagramBlock / CodeBlockEditor
description: Code colored as code, math set as it is typed, diagrams the app draws from their source, dividers, tables that grow and merge cells, pictures to resize and align, pages to open, columns, and synced copies that change together.

title: TodoItem / Checklist
description: To-dos under a title, with how many are done as a count and a bar; a done one goes quiet and struck through.

title: MarkdownRenderer / TableOfContents / DocumentOutline / ReadingProgress
description: Markdown as a document, its headings marked for a table of contents beside it: the section in view is lit as it scrolls, and a press brings a section to the top. The bar above fills as the text scrolls. DocumentOutline is the same TableOfContents.

title: DocumentViewer / PDFViewer / PageThumbnailList
description: Pages the app drew, on a desk: the page in view and its count, zoom by steps or to the width, the pages as thumbnails beside, a find bar whose hits light on the page, and notes pinned where a press puts them. The app reads its PDF; the viewer shows it.

title: OfficePreview
description: A slide deck, a sheet or a document the app turned into pages, shown by the same viewer.

title: EpubReader
description: A book a chapter at a time, in a column sized for reading: how far through the chapter, the chapters listed, the type a step larger or smaller, and the next chapter a press away.

title: Footnote / Glossary / TooltipTerm
description: A note's number in running text, the note a rest of the pointer away; a term underlined in dashes that explains itself; and every term in order under its letter.

title: FocusMode / ZenMode
description: Zen mode folds the tools away and sets the text in a quiet column; Escape brings them back.

title: PrintPreview
description: The pages the app laid out for the settings, small on a desk, with paper, turn, margins and copies beside; each change asks the app for new pages.

title: PageTree / Favorites / Pinned
description: Pages kept close at hand above the tree of every page: favorites open with a press, drag to reorder and let go by their star. The tree is lists::Tree, a page's emoji leading its label.

title: PageCover / PageIcon / PageProperties
description: A page's head: its cover, its icon set large over the cover's edge, its title, and its properties. Hover the cover to change or remove it, the icon to pick another. The properties are data_display::PropertyGrid, a field's editor in each row.

title: Backlinks / GraphView
description: The pages that link here, each with the words around its link; and every page as a node, its links as edges. GraphView is charts::NetworkGraph.

title: TemplatePicker
description: Pages to start from: found by name, kept by category, the one in view shown as it will read; Use takes it.

title: TrashBin
description: Deleted pages, newest first, with where each lived and when it went: restore one, delete one for good or empty it all, each final step asked twice.

title: VersionHistory / PageHistoryDiff
description: A page's versions by time and author: read one, or see word by word what it changed from the one before, added words washed and removed ones struck; restore any but the current.

title: PresenceAvatars / LiveIndicator / FollowMode / RemoteCursor / RemoteSelection
description: Who else is here, ringed in their colors, their carets and selections live in the text. Rest on someone to see where they are; press to follow their view, and Escape to stop.

title: CommentThread / Reply / Reactions / ReactionPicker
description: A conversation on the words it quotes: each comment with its author, time and reactions; a reply below, Enter to send; resolve above. Press a reaction to add yours or take it back, or pick another.

title: CommentBubble / CommentMarker
description: A mark beside the words a thread is about, with its count; a press opens the thread in a bubble over the page.

title: CommentSidebar
description: Every conversation down a column, open or resolved; a press picks one, and the one picked takes replies.

title: Annotation / Highlight
description: Stretches people marked, washed in their colors; the ones with a note are underlined, and resting on one shows it. A press picks one. A plain mark with no author is typography::Highlight.

title: SuggestionMode / TrackChanges
description: Editing changes the words; suggesting keeps them and proposes the change, removed words struck and added ones underlined in the author's color, each to accept or reject; viewing only reads. Type in the field while suggesting.

title: ShareDialog / InviteInput / PermissionSelect / AccessList
description: Sharing in one place: add people by email, each chip marked until it is an address; choose what they may do; change or take away anyone's access; and choose who the link lets in.

title: ActivityLog → data_display::ActivityFeed
description: What people did in the document, newest first.

title: ChatContainer / MessageList / MessageBubble / MessageAvatar / MessageHeader / MessageFooter / DateSeparator / ScrollToBottomButton
description: A conversation held at its newest message and drawn only near the view. Yours sit on the right in a quiet bubble; the assistant's read as prose beside its mark. Scroll up and it stays put, with a way back down that counts what arrived.

title: StreamingText / StreamingMarkdown / StreamingCursor
description: Text as it arrives: what came in shows at a steady pace and catches up when far behind, a caret where more will come; markdown takes shape as its lines land. The cursor alone waits for the first words.

title: CodeBlock
description: Code in a message: its language, copy, and the host's run, apply and download. Long code folds to its first lines until opened.

title: MathBlock / TableBlock / MermaidRenderer
description: Math is typography::Latex and tables are the markdown renderer's, in a message as in a document. A diagram arrives as the picture the host drew from its source.

title: ImageMessage / ImageGrid / FileMessage / AudioMessage / VideoMessage / LinkPreviewCard
description: What a message can carry: a picture in its own shape, pictures as a grid, a file, a voice note to play and scrub, a video over the host's frames, and a link unfolded.

title: QuoteReply / MessageActions / MessageEditor / BranchNavigator / RegenerateButton / StopGeneratingButton / ContinueButton
description: A quote to answer, the actions on a message, a sent message opened to change (the submit key saves, Escape cancels), the versions an answer has, and the buttons that regenerate, stop and continue.

title: ErrorMessage / RetryMessage / RateLimitNotice / FeedbackForm
description: An answer that failed and a way to try again; a limit reached, counting down to when it lifts; and after a bad mark, what went wrong.

title: ThinkingBlock / ReasoningPanel / ThinkingIndicator / ThinkingDuration
description: The reasoning behind an answer, folded under how long it took; open, its steps read in a quiet column. While the assistant works, a word says what it is doing.

title: CitationBadge / InlineCitation / SourceCard / SourceList / SourcesPanel
description: Where an answer's words came from: a numbered pill after the claim, its source a rest of the pointer away; the sources folded under the answer, each a card.

title: SearchProgress / WebResultCard / DocumentChunkPreview
description: A search as it runs, step by step; a result as the web gives it; and a passage found in a document, the words that matched washed.

title: PromptInput / Composer / AttachmentButton / AttachmentChip / AttachmentPreview / PasteImagePreview / DragDropOverlay / ContextChips / SlashCommandMenu / ContextMentionMenu / SendButton / InputHint
description: Where a message is written: attachments and context above the field, tools below, send at the end; Enter sends and Shift-Enter breaks the line. A slash at the start offers commands, an at sign offers context, and files dropped on it attach.

title: ModelSelector / ModeSelector / ToolToggleMenu / PromptTemplateMenu
description: The model is a forms::Select with a note on each; the mode a buttons::SegmentedControl; tools and saved prompts are menus::DropdownMenu, one with checks and one that inserts a prompt.

title: TemperatureSlider / ParameterPanel / SystemPromptEditor / TokenCounter / ContextWindowMeter / CostEstimator
description: How answers are made: each knob a slider with its value; the instructions every answer follows, counted against their limit; how full the context is; and what a message may cost. The context meter is data_display::UsageBar.

title: ConversationList / ConversationItem / ConversationSearch / NewChatButton
description: Conversations down a sidebar, pinned first, then by day; the one open marked with its menu, the others show theirs on hover or focus. The search is a forms::SearchInput; the list keeps titles that hold every word.

title: FolderList / ProjectList / ProjectKnowledgePanel
description: Projects that hold conversations, each with how many; and what a project knows beyond the conversation, how full that knowledge is, with a way to add more.

title: SharedConversationView / ConversationExport
description: A conversation someone shared, to read and carry on; and saving one to a file, in a format, with or without its thinking.

title: WelcomeScreen / Greeting / SuggestionChips / StarterPrompts / CapabilityCards
description: The first thing a new conversation shows: a greeting for the time of day, the composer, prompts to start from and what the assistant can do; a press fills the composer.

title: FollowUpSuggestions
description: Questions to ask next, under an answer; a press asks one.

title: PromptLibrary
description: Saved prompts, found by name and kept by category, the one in view shown whole: documents::TemplatePicker over prompts.

title: ToolCallCard / ToolCallGroup
description: Each call an assistant makes: a mark for where it stands, the tool, what it touched and how long it took; a press opens its arguments and what came back. Several calls fold under one line.

title: ToolApprovalDialog / PermissionPrompt
description: Asking first: a dialog before one call runs, with its arguments, where Escape denies; and a prompt in place that allows once, always, or not at all.

title: AgentStepList / TaskTimeline / AgentPlan / TodoList / AgentStatus / AgentProgress
description: An agent's work as it goes: its steps down a rail, its plan ticking off as each item finishes, where it stands in a word, and how far it has come. The button finishes the next item.

title: SubAgentTree
description: Agents an agent sent out, and theirs in turn, each with where it stands: lists::Tree, a node per agent with its state as its note, a failed one tinted.

title: FileChangeCard / MultiFileDiff Review / CommandExecutionCard
description: What an agent would change, file by file: how much moves, the diff a press away, and a verdict each or for all; in a side panel the counts and verdicts wrap below. A command it ran is terminal::CommandBlock.

title: BrowserPreview / ScreenshotStream / ComputerUseViewer
description: What an agent sees as it works, in frames from the host: a browser with its address and the frames so far, a press on one shows it; and a screen with where the agent points, a ring for each new point, and what it does there.

title: ArtifactPanel / ArtifactVersionSwitcher / LivePreview
description: What an agent made, in a panel of its own: the version shown among all, copy and download, the artifact as preview or source; the version switcher is chat::BranchNavigator. A live preview holds the host's page with its address and reload.

title: SandboxStatus
description: Where an agent's sandbox stands: a dot and a word, what it uses of what it has, and how long it has run. A dot rings while it starts or works.

title: MCPServerList / ConnectorList / ToolRegistry Panel
description: Servers and connectors the agent can reach, each with where it stands and a switch; and every tool they bring, found by name, each allowed, asked for first, or denied.

title: MemoryPanel / CheckpointList / Rewind
description: What an agent keeps between conversations, a line to add to it and a way to forget; and the points it can go back to, newest first, the one it stands on marked.

title: InterruptButton / HumanInputRequest
description: A way to stop an agent mid-task and pick it up again; and a question it waits on, with answers to pick or a line to write one. Once answered, the card keeps the answer.

title: TokenUsageChart / CostBreakdown
description: Tokens each turn spent, split into what the model read, what it wrote and what came from the cache; and what the session cost, part by part.

title: TraceViewer / EvalResultTable
description: A run as spans on a track for each depth: the session, its turns, and the calls in each; the wheel zooms and a press picks a span. Then how an agent did on a set of cases, sortable by any column.

title: ImageGenerationPanel / PromptEnhancer / NegativePromptInput / StylePresetPicker / AspectRatioPicker / SeedInput
description: A picture's settings in one form: the prompt, which Enhance offers to fill out, the words it adds washed; what to leave out; a style; a shape; and a seed, empty for a new one each run. Cmd-Enter generates.

title: GenerationQueue
description: Generations in line: each shows its picture or where it stands, its prompt, and how far it has come. Cancel while it waits or runs, Retry once it fails, Remove once it ends; a retried job folds back in at the end.

title: GenerationGrid / ImageCompare
description: A run's results in its shape: a breathing placeholder with its percent while one comes, the picture once done, or why it failed with Retry. Beside it, an upscale against its source; drag the divider or use Left and Right.

title: VariationPicker / ABCompareView
description: Variations of one picture, the chosen one large; vary it a little or a lot, or upscale it. Then two models' answers side by side, blind until you pick the better or call a tie.

title: InpaintCanvas / MaskBrush
description: A picture to repaint in part: paint a mask where it should change, erase where it went too far; the mask washes over the picture. On the canvas, [ and ] size the brush and X swaps painting for erasing. Undo takes the last stroke, Clear takes them all.

title: AudioGenerationPlayer
description: A generated sound: its prompt, model and length, a bar while it is made, then a player whose waveform lights as it plays. A press on the waveform seeks, and so do Left and Right once it has focus.

title: TTSVoicePicker
description: Voices to speak with: play a sample, then choose one by its row. The chosen voice takes the active wash and a check; tags drop below the name when narrow.

title: VideoGenerationTimeline
description: A video made shot by shot along its time: each shot as wide as it runs, its poster once made, a placeholder while it comes. Choose a shot to read it; Extend asks for the next.

title: ModelCard
description: A model to choose: its maker, what it does, facts such as its size and license, and what it can do. The one in use says so; the others offer Use.

title: ModelDownloadManager
description: Models on their way to this machine: how much of how much, how fast and how long is left, with Pause and Resume, Cancel, Retry, and Delete once a model is here.

title: ModelStatus / HardwareMonitor
description: Models on this machine, loaded, loading or not, with the GPU memory each holds; and the machine at work, each part's meter turning amber then red as it fills, beside its recent history.

title: FineTuneJobCard
description: A fine-tuning job: the base model and data it learns from, where it stands, how far it has come by epoch, and its loss on training and held-out data.

title: DatasetViewer → tables::DataTable
description: Samples of a dataset: a prompt, its answer, its split and its length. Sort by any column, page through, and open a sample to read it whole.

title: EmbeddingVisualizer
description: Notes placed by what they mean, colored by topic, flat or turned in three dimensions. Drag the turned one, or use the arrow keys. The pointer names a note; the legend hides a topic.

title: PromptPlayground
description: A prompt to try. Each {name} in the template gets a field, and the prompt below marks what is still blank. Run waits for every value, then shows the answer with its tokens and time.

title: PromptDiff / PromptVersionHistory
description: A prompt's versions, newest first, and what the chosen one changed: words taken out struck through, words put in washed green. Restore brings an older one back as the newest.

title: ImageViewer
description: A picture to look at closely. It fits at first; the buttons, plus and minus, or Cmd-scroll zoom it, and 0 and 1 go back to fit and actual size, as a double press does. Drag it or use the arrows once it overhangs; R turns it.

title: ImageThumbnail / Lightbox → overlays::Lightbox
description: Pictures small, each in its own shape, with a label when one helps. The one last opened keeps a ring; a press or Enter opens the lightbox, which steps through them all.

title: ImageCropper
description: A box to crop a picture by. Drag it to move it and its handles to size it; with a shape, only its corners size it. The arrows move it, Shift further.

title: ImageUpload
description: A picture to send: drop one or browse for it, then crop it. Replace picks another; Remove empties it.

title: ImageAnnotator
description: Marks on a picture: boxes, arrows, lines drawn freehand, numbered pins. Pick a tool and a color above; with Select, a press chooses a mark and Delete removes it. Cmd-Z undoes.

title: VideoPlayer
description: A video the host plays, a frame at a time. Its controls fade once the pointer rests while it plays. Space plays, J and L jump ten seconds, C turns captions, F fills the screen.

title: VideoTimeline / Scrubber
description: Where a video stands: what has loaded, how far it has played, its chapters, and the time under the pointer. A press or a drag seeks; with focus the arrows step five seconds.

title: VideoThumbnailStrip
description: Frames along the video under its playhead, and the part kept between two handles. A press seeks; a handle trims; I and O set the ends at the playhead.

title: SubtitleEditor
description: Captions to edit in place, their times as mm:ss.mmm over their words. The one under the playhead is lit; Add puts a new cue there.

title: AudioPlayer
description: A song the host plays: its cover, the time played and left along a scrubber, the transport and the volume.

title: AudioWaveform
description: A sound's peaks, dark as far as it has played. A press or a drag seeks, the time under the pointer shows above it, and with focus the arrows step five seconds.

title: AudioSpectrum / Visualizer
description: Sound by pitch, low to high. The host sends new levels as it plays; they hold while it pauses.

title: VolumeControl
description: A speaker that mutes, drawn by the level, beside a slider. Muted, the slider rests at zero; moving it unmutes.

title: PlaybackSpeedControl
description: How fast it plays, from half to double, chosen from a menu.

title: MediaControls
description: Shuffle, back, play, forward and repeat. Shuffle and repeat stay lit while on; repeat steps from all to one to off.

title: Playlist
description: Songs in order. The one under way is lit, its bars moving while it plays; Enter or a double press plays another.

title: ScreenRecorderControls
description: Record, then pause, resume or stop. While it runs, a live dot and the time it has run; the mic and camera toggles choose what it takes.

title: CameraPreview
description: What a camera sees, in its own shape, from frames the host hands in. With no frame, the camera is off.

title: MicLevelMeter
description: A microphone's level as it comes in: amber near the top, red at the top.

title: DeviceSelector
description: A microphone, a camera or a speaker to use, each with its kind's icon. With none attached, it says so and stays shut.

title: 3DModelViewer
description: A model the host renders, a frame for each view. A drag or the arrows turn around it; Command-scroll, + and - bring it nearer; 0 or the reset button returns.

title: FileIcon
description: A file's icon by its name's extension: code, text, pictures, sound, video, archives, tables, fonts and scripts; a folder shut or open.

title: FileItem
description: A file or folder as a row: its icon and name over its size and when it changed.

title: FileList
description: A folder's entries in columns, as lists::DirectoryListing draws them: sort by a column, climb the path, open with Enter or a double press.

title: FileGrid
description: Files and folders as tiles. A press picks one and a double press opens it; with focus the arrows move by tile and by row, and Enter opens.

title: FileExplorer
description: A folder three ways: a list that sorts by column, tiles, or columns that walk the path. Its name, its count and a switch sit above the path, which climbs; a folder opens in place.

title: FolderTree
description: The same folders as lists::FileTree draws them: folders first, a filter above, Enter or a double press opens a file.

title: FileContextMenu
description: What a right press on files offers, as menus::ContextMenu draws it: open, rename, duplicate, and the trash apart.

title: RenameInline
description: A name edited in place, as forms::InlineEdit does it: a press or Enter edits, Enter keeps and Escape drops; the icon follows the new name.

title: DragDropFiles
description: Files dropped in, as forms::DropZone takes them; each lands in the list below.

title: FilePreview / QuickLook
description: A file shown large: its picture in its shape, its text's first lines, or its kind. Space on a picked tile shows it over the page, as a quick look does; Escape puts it away.

title: RecentFiles
description: Files opened lately, newest first, under a header for each day. Enter or a double press opens one.

title: Favorites / Bookmarks
description: Places pinned for quick reach, as documents::Favorites keeps them: a press opens one, a drag reorders, the star lets one go.

title: FileSearch
description: A search over files: the host searches as the name is typed, and each file found shows its folder. Enter or a double press opens one.

title: DuplicateFinder
description: Files found more than once, each copy with a mark; the last copy a group keeps stays. What the marked copies free sits beside Remove.

title: ArchiveViewer
description: What an archive holds, as a tree of its folders: each file with its size and how much packing saved.

title: HexViewer
description: A file's first bytes, as debug::HexViewer shows them: offsets, hex and text side by side.

title: FileOperationProgress
description: A copy or a move under way: what it does and where to, a bar, the bytes done with the time left, and the file it takes now. Pause, resume and cancel while it runs.

title: TransferQueue
description: Uploads and downloads in one queue: which way each goes, its bar and status, and pause, resume, retry or cancel as its state allows.

title: DownloadManager
description: Downloads as a browser keeps them: those on their way above, the finished below under Clear. A finished one opens with a press and shows its folder.

title: StorageUsage
description: Where a disk's room goes, as data_display::UsageBar shows it: a part a kind, and what is left free.

title: ChannelList / ChatList
description: Channels and people in sections, each a list: a press, an arrow or Enter opens a chat and clears what waited. Unread names stand out; a muted channel keeps quiet.

title: ChannelItem / DirectMessageItem
description: A channel by its mark, a hash or a lock, with its unread count, quiet when muted, pinned with a pin; a person with their presence on their initials.

title: ChannelHeader
description: A channel's name and topic, and beside them its members, its pins and a call; the actions drop below on a narrow window.

title: PinnedMessages
description: Messages pinned in a chat, newest first: a press, an arrow or Enter opens one where it stands; Unpin lets one go.

title: ChatMessage / UnreadDivider / MessageReactions / TypingIndicator
description: Messages under their day: one author's messages within five minutes form a run, the head only on the first and the time in the gutter on hover. A rule marks where unread ones start. Reactions and a thread sit under a message, and a line says who is typing.

title: MessageThread / ThreadPanel
description: A thread's mark under its message: who replied, how many, and when the last came; a press opens the thread. The panel holds the first message, a rule counting the replies, the replies in their runs, and a composer at the bottom.

title: ReadReceipt
description: Where a sent message stands: a clock while it goes, one tick once sent, two once delivered, two in the info tone once read. Read in a group, it shows who saw it.

title: MemberList / UserProfileCard
description: Members online and offline by name, each group under its count; offline members go quiet. A press or an arrow shows a member's card: their standing, title and status, the time where they are, and ways to reach them.

title: OnlineStatus
description: Where someone stands, as a dot in its color and its word.

title: StatusSetter
description: An emoji, a few words, and when they clear. A suggestion fills all three; Save sets the status, and Clear status removes it.

title: CallControls / VoiceCallBar / HuddleIndicator
description: A huddle's mark rings while it is live; a press joins. In the call, a bar tells where it is, how long it has run and who is in it, and the controls turn the microphone, camera and a shared screen on and off, or leave.

title: ParticipantTile / VideoCallGrid
description: Everyone in the call as tiles in even rows, a short last row centered: a camera's frame or the person's initials, their name with a mark when muted, and a ring while they speak. Your tile follows the controls above.

title: ScreenShareView
description: A shared screen in its shape under a bar that names who presents, the call's tiles beside it. Share your screen from the controls above, and the bar offers Stop presenting.

title: IncomingCallDialog
description: A call coming in: the caller ringing, their name and the kind of call, with Decline and Accept. Escape declines.

title: StickerPicker
description: Stickers a pack at a time, chosen above; a search spans every pack and keeps the stickers whose names hold it. Arrows move, and Enter or a press sends one.

title: GifPicker
description: GIFs from the host in two columns packed tight, each moving. The host answers the search as it changes; while it is empty, categories fill it. Each GIF is a Tab stop that a press, Enter or Space sends.

title: MailboxList / FolderList
description: Mailboxes, folders and labels in sections: a press, an arrow or Enter opens one, and the one open is lit. A box with mail unread stands out with its count; a label wears its hue.

title: MailList / MailItem
description: Messages with the sender strong while unread, the subject and first words under it, when each came, a paperclip for files, and a star to press. A press or an arrow selects; Command or Shift takes several.

title: InboxZeroState → EmptyState
description: An inbox with nothing left in it says so, calm and brief.

title: MailReader / QuotedText
description: A message open for reading: the subject, who wrote to whom and when, replies, the words and the files. Words quoted from before fold behind a small mark until pressed.

title: MailThreadView
description: A conversation, oldest first: the newest stands open, and the others fold to a line of who, their first words and when, which a press, Enter or Space opens.

title: MailComposer / RecipientInput → TagInput
description: To, and Cc and Bcc once asked for, suggest people as you type and mark what is not an address. Then the subject, the words, the files and the signature. Send wakes once there is someone to send to, now or at a time; Discard lets the draft go.

title: SignatureEditor
description: A signature's lines in a field, and under it how they will sit below a message.

title: LabelPicker
description: The labels a message wears: the field finds them by name, arrows move, and a press or Enter turns one on or off. A name no label has can be made into one, on at once.

title: SnoozePicker
description: Put a message off until later today, tomorrow, this weekend or next week, each with its day and hour, or until a time of your own.

title: ScheduleSend
description: Send now, or open the arrow for tomorrow morning, tomorrow afternoon, Monday morning, or a day and hour of your own.

title: CalendarMonthView
description: A month in week rows. What spans days lies across them, the rest sits by the hour, and a crowded day keeps the rest behind N more. Arrows move a day, Page keys turn the month, and Enter or a double press opens the day.

title: MiniCalendar → forms::Calendar
description: A month at a glance is forms::Calendar. Here a day picked in it turns the month view above to its month.

title: CalendarWeekView / TimeGrid / AllDayRow / CurrentTimeIndicator
description: A week under its days' names: whole days lie above, the rest by their hours, and events that overlap share the width. A drag on empty time makes an event of a quarter hour or more, and a drag on an event's lower edge moves its end. Today carries a line at the minute now.

title: CalendarDayView / TimezoneOverlay
description: One day, with another zone's hours beside its own, so a call across zones reads in both.

title: AgendaView
description: The days ahead with their events under each day's name, whole days first, then by the hour; days with nothing are left out. A press or an arrow selects, Enter or a double press opens.

title: EventPopover / AttendeeList
