description: An event's chip opens its details: when and where, who is asked and what each said, and what can be done with it. The list of guests stands on its own too.

title: EventEditor / RecurrenceEditor / ReminderPicker
description: An event's parts in a form: its title, whole days or hours, where, its color, how it repeats with the next days it falls on, its reminders and notes. Save waits for a title and an end after the start; saved, every view on the page shows the change.

title: AvailabilityPicker
description: Times to meet over the working days ahead: each day with its count of open slots, then the slots of the one chosen. What the page's events take is closed.

title: YearView
description: Twelve small months. A day with something on it wears a dot in its first event's hue; arrows move a day, Page keys a month, and Enter or a double press opens the day.

title: EventCard / EventChip
description: An event in a line, by its hour or across whole days, and as a block with its hours and place, the way a time grid holds it.

title: PriorityIndicator / IssueIdBadge
description: How urgent a task is in three bars, urgent in red, its words in a tip or beside it. An issue goes by its team's key and its number.

title: StatusSelect / AssigneePicker / DueDatePicker
description: A task's properties: where it stands in its workflow, who has it, and when it is due; DueDatePicker is the forms DatePicker. Each change shows in the list below.

title: TaskItem / TaskList
description: Tasks in rows: a box ticks one done, then its priority, its issue and its title; the due day and who has it sit at the end, and a day past due reads in red. Arrows move between rows; Enter or a double press opens one.

title: SubtaskList
description: A task's steps with how many are done, as a count and a bar. It is the documents Checklist, whose field adds a step on Enter.

title: KanbanBoard / KanbanColumn / KanbanCard · IssueCard · Sprint Board
description: Columns of issue cards for a sprint. A card drags to a place in any column while the others glide aside, Option with an arrow moves the focused one, and a press or Enter opens it in the panel below. Sprint Board is this board.

title: TaskDetailPanel
description: A task in full beside the board: its title edits in place, its properties change where they stand, and its notes and steps follow. Each edit shows on the board and in the list.

title: LabelManager
description: A team's labels: a press on a hue picks another, a name edits in place, and the field at the end makes a new one. Names stay unique whatever their case, and each change shows on the cards.

title: GanttChart / TimelineView · Roadmap
description: A roadmap lays initiatives across months in lanes, each bar filled as far as it has come, under a line at today; hover a bar for its dates. GanttChart and TimelineView are the charts GanttChart, for tasks by the day.

title: Burndown Chart
description: Work left over a sprint: the ideal line from the scope down to nothing, what was left at each day's end so far, and a line at today. Work added mid-sprint lifts the line. Hover a day to read it. It lives with the charts as BurndownChart.

title: MilestoneProgress
description: A milestone's issues done as a bar and a count, when it is due, and whether it keeps pace: on track, at risk when the work trails the time gone, late past its day, or done.

title: WorkloadView
description: Who carries how much this sprint: each person's points against what they can take, the bar turning red past it.

title: TimeTracker
description: Time against a task: name it, Start or Enter starts the clock, and Stop turns it into an entry. Today's entries sit under it with their total.

title: Pomodoro Timer
description: Focus for twenty-five minutes, rest for five, and after the fourth round for fifteen. The ring counts the phase down around the time left; a phase that ends waits for Start.

title: DatabaseView
description: The studio's tasks five ways: a table, a board by status, a gallery of cards, a month calendar by due day, and a timeline from start to due. A card moved on the board takes its column's status, and a record opens in the panel above.

title: InfiniteCanvas · CanvasGrid / Guides · Ruler · ArtboardFrame · ZoomControls / ZoomIndicator · MiniMap
description: An endless plane: a dot grid that thins as it zooms out, rulers in canvas units, guides, and artboards with their names. Drag to pan, scroll to move, and hold Command to zoom about the pointer. The zoom steps in fixed stops, and the minimap moves the view to a press.

title: ToolPalette · SelectionBox · TransformHandles · SnapIndicator · ShapeTools · PenTool / PathEditor · TextTool · BrushTool / BrushSettings · HistoryPanel
description: Tools at work on the plane. Select presses a shape, Shift adds, a drag moves it and snaps its edges to the others, a handle resizes it, and a drag on empty space draws a marquee. The shape tools draw by a drag, Shift keeping them square; the pen adds a point per press and a double press ends the path; text drops a line; the brush strokes. Each change is a step in the history, which a double press or Enter takes back to.

title: LayerPanel · InspectorPanel · AlignmentToolbar · AssetPanel
description: Panels on the drawing above. The layers list it topmost first: a box shows or hides a layer, F2 renames it, a drag restacks it. The inspector edits the one selected; the toolbar lines up or spreads several; an asset pressed lands on the canvas. Each change is a step in the history.

title: ColorPanel · GradientPanel · ShadowEditor · BorderEditor · TypographyPanel
description: What a shape looks like. The color panel sets its fill, over the document's colors; the gradient panel is forms::GradientEditor; shadows stack; a border's corners join or split; the type panel sets a style over a line of it. The card takes each edit.

title: ConstraintsEditor · AutoLayoutControls · ExportPanel
description: How a shape keeps to its frame and lays out its children, and what it exports to. The first box shows where a child pinned so lands once its frame grows from the dashed size; the second lays three children by the controls; export names each file once.

title: NodeEditor / NodeGraph · Node / Port / Edge / Connection
description: Nodes joined by wires, as in a pipeline editor. A title drags its node; a drag out of an output draws a wire that lands on an input of the same kind, each kind in its own hue. An input takes one wire, so a new one replaces the old; a press on a wired input lifts the wire to move it or let it go.

title: FlowChart / DiagramEditor · Connector Line
description: Steps joined by links that follow them: ends as ellipses, work as boxes, choices as diamonds, and words on a link. With Select a step moves, resizes, and takes new words on a double press; the connector draws a link from one step to another.

title: MindMap
description: Topics branching from a root, half to each side. A press selects; arrows walk, Tab adds a child and Enter a sibling, Delete removes one, and F2 or a double press rewrites it. The owner keeps the map.

title: Whiteboard · StickyNote
description: A board to think on, with its tools over its corner and its zoom at its foot. The note tool drops a sticky note, a double press writes on it, the connector links two notes, and Delete removes the selection. It keeps its own tool and view and hands the owner the whole board after each change.

title: ConnectionManager · ConnectionForm
description: Saved connections with their engine and address, or why one failed. Enter or a double press connects; the pencil opens one in the form, where Test tries it and Save keeps it.

title: SchemaTree · ERDiagram
description: A database's schemas, tables and views, each field with its type and keys marked. The diagram draws each table as a box of fields and a line from every foreign key to the field it points at; a table's title drags it.

title: QueryEditor → editor::CodeEditor · QueryResultGrid → tables::DataGrid · QueryHistory · QueryPlanViewer
description: A query in the code editor over its result in the data grid; the queries that ran, found by their text, each with how it ended, and one run again on Enter; and the plan, each step with its share of the cost.

title: TableStructureEditor · IndexManager
description: A table's fields edited in place: a name or a default rewritten on a press, a type, whether it may be empty, and the key. Its indexes list their fields and method, and a new one is drawn up from the table's fields.

title: RedisKeyBrowser
description: Keys found by a glob, each with its type and the time it has left; the key picked shows what it holds, laid out for its type.

title: DocumentViewer (MongoDB / JSON) → devtools::JsonViewer · JsonViewer / JsonTree · JsonEditor · YamlViewer · XmlViewer
description: A document as a tree: each key with its value, lists and maps with their counts; a search keeps what holds it and opens the way, and Enter on a value copies its path. The editor writes JSON with Format and Minify and says whether it reads. YAML reads as the same tree; XML as elements with their attributes and text.

title: ApiRequestBuilder · ResponseViewer · HeadersTable · QueryParamsEditor → forms::KeyValueInput · EnvironmentSelector · CollectionTree
description: Saved requests in folders; a drag moves one, and Enter opens it in the builder with its method and address, its query's pairs, headers, body and sign-in, and the address that goes out with the environment's variables filled in. Send brings back an answer: its status, time and size, then its body or its headers.

title: WebSocketConsole
description: A socket's conversation: where it stands, each message marked sent or received with its time, JSON indented, and a field that sends on Enter.

title: GraphQLExplorer
description: A schema's types and fields beside a query and its variables; Run brings back the answer as a tree.

title: RegexTester · Base64 / Encoder · ColorContrastChecker
description: A pattern tried against a sample with each match washed and its groups listed; text encoded or decoded as Base64, for a URL or as hex; and text on a background with the contrast between them and the WCAG levels it meets.

title: ContainerList · PodList · ResourceMonitor
description: Containers with where each stands and its load, started, stopped or restarted from its row; pods in a table narrowed by namespace; and a machine's readings, each with its latest value, its recent past and how full it is.

title: Dashboard Grid · Widget / DashboardCard · RefreshIntervalSelector · DashboardFilterBar · StatCard → data_display::Statistic · MetricsChart → charts::LineChart · ResourceGauge → data_display::Gauge
description: Widgets on a grid of twelve columns: a tile's top strip drags it and its corner resizes it, a cell at a time, while the others make room and rise to fill gaps; a focused tile steps with the arrows. Over it, the window of time and the filters, and how often it refreshes.

title: UptimeBar · ServiceStatus · HealthCheck Indicator
description: Sixty days of a service, a bar a day in the tone of its uptime; services under a line for the whole system; and checks with what each found, when it ran and how long it took.

title: AlertList · IncidentCard
description: Alerts with their severity, what raised them and since when; a firing one is acknowledged from its row. An incident with its severity and phase, what it touches, and its updates newest first.

title: EventStream · LogStream → terminal::LogViewer · TraceWaterfall → debug::TimelineProfiler · SystemMonitor → devtools::ResourceMonitor · ProcessTable → terminal::ProcessList · NetworkGraph (throughput) → charts::RealtimeChart
description: Events as they come, newest first, kept by kind, with Pause to hold the list while new ones count up. Logs, traces, a machine's readings, its processes and live throughput have their homes in the terminal, agent, dev tools and charts chapters; the maps live in the maps chapter.

title: SettingsLayout · SettingsSection · SettingsRow · SettingsSearch
description: A settings window: sections down the side and the open one beside them, the list going above in a narrow window. The search finds a setting by its name or the words it answers to, and Enter opens its section.

title: LoginForm · OAuthButtons
description: Sign in with a provider or with an email and a password. Sign in rests until the address reads and a password is typed; Enter in a field signs in, and a failed try says why above the button.

title: SignupForm
description: A name, an email and a new password, whose rules tick as they hold. Create account waits for every rule and the terms.

title: MagicLinkForm · ForgotPassword
description: A link by email: one that signs in, one that sets a new password. Once sent, each says where it went and offers it again.

title: TwoFactorInput
description: Six boxes for an authenticator's code; a full code goes at once. A code that fails clears the boxes and says so.

title: AccountSwitcher · WorkspaceSwitcher / OrgSwitcher · UserMenu
description: The account and the workspace in use, each a row that opens a menu of the others; the avatar opens who is signed in, the owner's rows, and Sign out.

title: ProfileCard · ProfileEditor
description: Someone at a glance, and their profile to edit: Save waits for a change, a name and an email that reads; Discard puts the saved profile back.

title: SessionList · ApiKeyManager
description: Where the account is signed in, this device first, each other one signing out on its own or all at once after a second press. API keys show their ends only; a new key's secret shows once.

title: SubscriptionCard / PlanBadge · UsageQuota · PaymentMethodForm
description: The plan with where it stands and what comes next; Cancel asks twice and Keep plan takes it back. Each limit's bar turns amber near it and red at it. A card saves once its number checks out, its month is ahead and its code is whole.

title: BillingHistory · UpgradePrompt / Paywall
description: Past bills with what each was for, its amount, date and state, and a download. A prompt past a limit stands as one line, or as a paywall with what the next plan brings.

title: TeamMemberTable · RoleSelector · InvitationList
description: Members with a role to change, each role saying what it may do, and a Remove that asks twice; the owner stays. Invitations out resend or revoke, and an address with a role invites someone new.

title: OnboardingWizard · WelcomeTour
description: A first run in a few steps: where it stands over a bar in as many parts, each step's title and line, and Next once its fields are ready. The welcome tour that follows is overlays::Tour.

title: Coachmark / Hotspot · FeatureHighlight / NewBadge
description: A hotspot's rings call out something new, and a press or Enter opens its tip. A highlight names a feature with a New badge over it; the badge alone marks a new row. Coachmarks are overlays::Spotlight.

title: Checklist (first-run tasks)
description: First things to do, counted in words and a bar. Start opens each; here it marks it done, and the check eases in. Once all are done, Hide puts it away.

title: HelpTooltip · InlineHelp · EmptyStateWithAction
description: A help mark beside a name shows its tip on hover; FormLabel's help is one. A line of help sits where it is needed, and Learn more opens the article in the panel below. An empty state with an action is feedback::EmptyState.

title: HelpPanel / DocsSidebar
description: Help beside the work: a search over the articles, one article with the way back, and links at its foot. A link to help:<key> opens another article.

title: KeyboardShortcutCheatsheet · WhatsNewDialog
description: Every shortcut in one dialog, its search taking focus as it opens; and what changed, newest first.

title: FeedbackWidget · ContactSupport
description: Four faces and a note, sent with one press; and a message to people, sent once it has a topic and words.

title: Draggable · Droppable / DropTarget · DragOverlay / DragPreview · DragGhost
description: gpui's own drag and drop: on_drag carries a value and builds the view that follows the pointer, drag_over lights a lane, can_drop refuses the lane a chip left, and on_drop takes it. Ely adds nothing.

title: Resizable · Rotatable · Selectable / SelectionArea · RubberBandSelection · Sortable
description: A box resized from its edges or its grip; a picture turned by its knob, as gpui turns svgs alone; tiles taken by a band drawn on empty space; rows sorted by drag through motion::Reorder.

title: LongPress · DoubleClick · Gesture · PanZoom
description: A long press is primitives::Pressable; a double press is gpui's click_count. The wheel pans and, with Command, zooms layout::Viewport; two fingers swipe lists::SwipeableListItem.

title: Hotkeys / KeyBinding · KeyChord
description: gpui's own bindings: actions! names them, bind_keys ties keys to them under a key context, and a binding of two strokes waits for the second while the first shows. Focus the box and try them. Ely adds nothing.

title: Undo / Redo Manager
description: forms::History keeps whole snapshots, the one every editor here undoes with; a burst of typing makes one step.

title: VirtualScroller · ScrollSync · InfiniteScroll Trigger
description: gpui's uniform_list draws only the rows in view, ten thousand here. Two panes scroll as one: a wheel on either takes the other along. An endless list is lists::InfiniteList.

title: Autofocus · RovingTabIndex · TypeAhead · FocusVisible
description: A field takes focus as it appears through gpui's window.focus. A toolbar keeps one Tab stop and the arrows walk it. Typing a row's first letters moves a list to it. The focus ring is primitives::FocusRing.

title: Surfaces
description: Warm neutrals. Depth comes from tone, not shadow.

title: Ink
description: Four steps of text. Blue marks focus and links.

title: Signals
description: Status colors, each with a quiet fill.

title: Series
description: Eight chart colors, even in weight.

title: Syntax
description: Code tokens sit below text in weight.

title: Type
description: Inter for words. JetBrains Mono for code.

title: Shape
description: Four radii. Three elevations.

title: Motion
description: Ease out to arrive. Springs only where a hand leads. Slowed to one second here.

title: ThemeEditor · DensityProvider · RadiusProvider · FontProvider · HighContrastMode · ReducedMotionProvider
description: The theme laid open: every change here applies to the whole gallery at once, the colors as the shown mode's own. The theme switch above is settings::ThemeSelector.

title: ThemeImporter · SyntaxThemes
description: A VS Code color theme dropped here reads into Ely's palette, the colors it leaves out kept from Ely's; Apply sets it on the whole gallery. Code palettes choose the colors of code for the mode shown.

title: Platform Style · IconThemeProvider · VibrancyBackground
description: The theme's platform decides window buttons and key caps, and starts as the system's. An icon theme lays an owner's rules over Ely's file icons. A frosted pane lets a blurred window's backdrop through; gpui blurs as vibrancy on macOS and acrylic on Windows, and sets Mica on Windows 11.

title: I18nProvider · Trans / LocalizedText
description: One locale for the app, a catalog of messages per locale. Every catalog holds the same keys; a missing key or argument fails.

title: LocaleNumber / LocaleDate
description: Each locale's separators and its short numeric date, from CLDR.

title: RTL layout
description: A right-to-left locale starts its stacks and sets its text at the right; pick עברית above. Ely's other components stay left to right.

title: SkipLink · KeyboardNavigationHelper
description: A link that shows only while focused and moves focus past the nav to the main part: Tab into the card, then Enter. Arrows among a group's items live in interaction::RovingFocus.

title: ColorBlindSafe Palette
description: Ely's chart hues share one lightness, so protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia run some together. The safe hues differ in lightness too: every pair stays apart for each, and each is 3:1 on its page.

title: MapView · MapMarker · MapPopup
description: Tiles come from the host by zoom, column and row; past the zooms it cuts, the nearest scales. Drag or scroll to pan, Command-scroll or the buttons to zoom; focused, the arrows pan and + and - zoom. A pin opens its popup; Escape closes it.

title: CoordinateDisplay
description: A place in degrees or in degrees, minutes and seconds, with its hemispheres; figures keep one width, and the button copies it.

title: LocationPicker
description: The place under the crosshair is the pick: pan by pointer or keys, and the owner hears each move.

title: RouteLine · GeoJSON Layer
description: A route along places in order, the short way across the date line. GeoJSON reads to features: areas washed and outlined with their holes open, lines stroked, points dotted. Both repeat on each world in view.

title: GeoHeatmap
description: Weighted places as heat, hotter where they crowd, scaled to the densest spot in view.

title: MapCluster
description: Pins that crowd one square of the world gather into a count; a pan keeps each group, a press shows its members whole.

title: ChoroplethMap · WorldMap
description: Areas washed by value on one hue's scale, with a legend; an area without a value reads as no data. WorldMap washes Natural Earth's countries by ISO code: Singapore, too small at this scale, draws nowhere and is logged once.

title: Clock / WorldClock
description: The time in a zone, a face over its digits, ticking each second. A world clock lays places in rows: how each one's day and hour stand against home.

title: Stopwatch
description: Time that runs while started and holds while paused, in tenths. Lap marks the time so far; once paused, it reads Reset and clears it.

title: Calculator
description: Digits, the four operations, sign, delete and clear, worked in precedence; keys type too, and Enter gives the result.

title: UnitConverter
description: An amount read in another unit: length, area, volume, mass, temperature, speed and data, with a swap.

title: QRCodeScanner
description: A camera's view with a square to aim at, reading QR codes off the main thread from frames the host hands in. gpui has no camera, so the gallery hands in one frame of its own.

title: Captcha
description: A picture of characters to copy, from the owner, who checks the answer and says how it stood; the refresh asks for another picture.

title: BarcodeDisplay · Signature · Rating Widget
description: Each has one home, shown on its own chapter's page: BarcodeDisplay is data_display::Barcode, Signature is forms::SignaturePad, and Rating Widget is forms::Rating.

title: Poll / Survey
description: A poll turns to results once the owner holds the vote, with Change vote on the same stop. A survey asks on one page and sends when every question has its answer.

title: Quiz / Flashcard
description: A quiz checks each answer and shows the right one, then the score. Flashcards turn on a press and go round the deck.

title: ChangeLog Viewer
description: ChangeLog Viewer is data_display::Changelog, shown on the Data Display page.

title: LicenseViewer
description: The packages a product ships, each with its license, beside the chosen one's text. These are Ely's own.

title: Terms / Consent Dialog / CookieBanner
description: Terms to agree to before going on, and cookies to choose when the app shows web content. Each hands its answer to the owner.

title: ExportDialog / ImportDialog / CSVImporter
description: Data out in a format the owner writes, and data in: columns mapped to the app's fields, matched by name to start, and a CSV file read into records through the same mapping.

title: WebView / HTMLPreview
description: A native web view laid over its box: an address, or HTML the owner hands in, which makes it an HTML preview. It draws above everything gpui paints and follows the box each frame.

title: IframeEmbed / EmbedCard
description: A page from another address in a frame of its own, with Open in browser. EmbedCard is chat::LinkPreviewCard, shown on the AI Chat page.

title: PrintButton · ShareSheet
description: ShareSheet is buttons::ShareButton, shown on the Buttons & Actions page.

title: InspectorOverlay
description: gpui's inspector, which debug builds have, drawn in Ely's look. Inspect opens it at the window's right: hovering picks a box and shows its margin, border, padding and size over the page, the wheel steps out to the boxes around it, and a press holds it.

title: FPSMeter / PerfOverlay
description: Frames per second over the last second, the worst frame, and a bar per frame against the 60 Hz budget: green on time, amber a frame late, red later. It keeps the window drawing while shown, so Measure shows it only while you look.

title: RenderCounter
description: How often the view that draws it renders. The page's count climbs with every frame the window draws; the view beside it is drawn cached, so it renders only when it redraws itself or the window refreshes.

title: EventLogger
description: The input events that reach what it holds, newest first: presses, releases, moves run together while the pointer travels, wheels, keys and modifiers, each timed from the first.

title: DesignTokenViewer
description: The theme's shared colors and scales in the mode shown, each named as code reads it: every palette, syntax, chart and terminal color with its hex, and the type, radius, control, icon, avatar and container sizes, the elevations and the spacing steps.

title: IconBrowser
description: The library's icons, searchable: this is forms::IconPicker, its home. Pick one to see the name code uses.

title: A11yChecker
description: The theme's contrast in the mode shown: each text color over the surfaces it sits on and each code color over the editor's at 4.5:1, the focus ring and the chart hues beside the page at 3:1, failures first. Ely's palettes pass in both modes, with high contrast and without.

title: ScreenshotTest Harness
description: The gallery photographs itself: --capture writes every page top to bottom, light and dark, then each page's scripted states, with input posted to its own event queue. Each pass starts its page fresh, and reduced motion holds the shots still.

title: ComponentGallery / Storybook
description: This app is the gallery: a page per chapter of the library, light and dark, each with scripted states. The --page flag opens one page, and --capture photographs every page and state.

title: PlaygroundPanel
description: A component beside the knobs that shape it: a switch, a choice or a number edits one property, and the preview redraws.

title: RenderSurface
description: The host draws every pixel of each frame at the box's size in device pixels, here a field of three sources in contour bands. The slider moves a source; the frame draws again only for a new size or revision. Shaders, cameras, video and other GPU work run on the host's side and hand their frames in: gpui shares no device, so zero-copy textures and Metal, OpenGL, Vulkan or Direct3D surfaces have no way in.
